contract.validPayload: ticketDefaultAmount must be a positive numeric string and ticketDefaultSlippage must be a 0..100 percent string.
contract.legacyPayload: missing slippage remains supported through the existing 1% default.
contract.malformedPayload: nonnumeric amount, nonpositive amount, malformed slippage, or out-of-range slippage rejects before visible Account settings state applies.
